d: Wavy, shoulder-length platinum white hair with sweeping bangs frames a mature, middle-aged face featuring stern, narrow ice-blue eyes. A muscular, broad build is encased in heavy plate armor of polished silver and deep navy, accented by gold trim, a brown fur collar, and a flowing teal cape. The attire includes a chainmail tunic under a dark grey waist-cloth, paired with ornate silver greaves and a large white shield depicting a stylized bird. A heavy, silver-bladed polearm with a blue-banded shaft is held in a gloved hand.
